_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in. drive_backup_dir is optional — a Google Drive folder is auto-detected on macOS and Linux and snapshots go to <drive root>/trans.
_ticker_sectors_note: Map your holdings to a sector key. Valid keys are the keys of SECTOR_METRICS in app/sectors.py. Anything unmapped falls back to a generic metric set, so this is optional but improves the Fundamentals tab.
